data.title: 约尔·福杰 · 厨房茶桌上的第一杯红茶
data.description: 约尔穿常服连衣裙、系好居家围裙，坐在厨房的小茶桌旁。一手握住茶壶把手，另一手轻扶壶盖，把红茶缓缓倒入桌上的一只白瓷杯。她低头看着茶水没有溅出，红眸里露出松了口气的笑意。身旁碟子里放着饼干，窗边柔光照亮黑发与金色耳饰。
data.promptProse: At a small kitchen table, Yor Forger tips a teapot with one hand while the other steadies its lid. The SPY x FAMILY homemaker wears a tied household apron over a casual dress. Ruby eyes follow the thin stream of tea into a white cup on the table, and her smile relaxes when nothing spills. Black hair and gold earrings catch the window light; biscuits wait on a small plate beside the cup. One seated woman, clear contact between hands and teapot, unmarked crockery.
data.action: 坐在厨房小桌旁，一手握壶柄另一手扶壶盖，将红茶倒入桌上白瓷杯。
